raised.$description: Subtly above sibling content — NavigationMenu viewport indicator.

docked.$description: Fixed/positioned local elements — Sidebar, NavigationMenu bar, Resizable drag handle, InputOTP active caret.

focus.$description: A locally-focused element above unfocused siblings — Calendar day cell.
